purpose: Pressure dynamic cross-tool composition from verified browser state into a DOCX whose values are sourced from prior structured state rather than repeated literally in the goal.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://httpbin.org/forms/post, enter PROJECT BRAIN into the customer name field, choose Medium pizza size, check the Bacon topping, submit the form, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/DYNAMIC_DOCX_BROWSER.png, and save the result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/DYNAMIC_DOCX_BROWSER.json. Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/DYNAMIC_DOCX_NORMALIZED.json containing a top-level submissions object with exactly one record named httpbin whose status is VERIFIED_BROWSER_SUBMISSION and whose customer_name, size, topping, and final_url values come from the browser result. Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/DYNAMIC_BROWSER_REPORT.docx from that normalized JSON with title Browser Submission Report, paragraph Verified browser submission, and a two-column table with headers Field and Value containing one row for each of customer_name, size, topping, and final_url using their values from the normalized JSON. Finally independently reopen the DOCX and verify every requested value matches the normalized JSON.
